recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Re-adding an adjudication-level decision element or reverting the binding strength would conflict with later applied/published Financial Management decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-22660 was Published and resolved Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to clarify that ClaimResponse.outcome reports processing state rather than adjudication decision, and to add a 0..1 CodeableConcept decision element using an example decision value set.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-22660. The closest implementation is f952b5321de9cdbcb7b2521862890c757e21d530, which changed ClaimResponse.outcome's comment to describe processing states, added ClaimResponse.decision, and added the claim-decision CodeSystem and ValueSet.
additional_context: ClaimResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. Later decisions FHIR-22662 and FHIR-40082 moved item-level decision content into reviewOutcome, and FHIR-53057 changed ClaimResponse.decision and reviewOutcome.decision bindings to preferred. Those related issues already have audit commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source defines ClaimResponse.outcome as a processing outcome, includes ClaimResponse.decision for the overall adjudication result, and includes ClaimResponse.item.reviewOutcome.decision for item-level adjudication results.

related_jiras.note: Later published item-level ClaimResponse decision/outcome work moved item-level content into reviewOutcome.
Published refinement completed FHIR-22662 and aligned reviewOutcome.decision with the existing ClaimResponse.decision element.
Applied R6 Financial Management decision changed ClaimResponse.decision and reviewOutcome.decision bindings to preferred.
